text: Pay more attention to people, not to the roles that they play in your life. Learn to separate the person from their action. Do not love for the good done to you, and do not hate if someone made a mistake or caused you pain. Love is free from conventions that may be important at the level of the third chakra. Remember that behind any actions hides a soul that, like yours, strives for love and goes through a difficult human path. This does not mean that you should justify harmful behavior, but such an approach allows you to preserve compassion and not close your heart.
